 ✅ Torino-Monza, official line-ups: Fitz-Jim, Simeone, Robinson and Mota 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Serie A is back! Torino and Monza kick off matchday eight tonight at 20:45 at the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino. Ignazio Abate's Torino, coming off wins over Udinese and Parma, are chasing a third straight victory to maintain their fine form.
 Watch every Serie BKT match live with LaB Channel on OneFootball: subscribe for just €9.99 a month! 
 OneFootball Videos
 They face a Monza side led by former Torino coach Ivan Juric, buoyed by their 4-0 thrashing of Cagliari and spearheaded by Gustavo Varela , who already has six league goals. Monza also knocked Torino out of the Coppa Italia in September.
 Seven points from their last three games for Torino, six for Monza: two confident teams meet in a matchday opener that promises plenty of entertainment, with valuable points at stake, particularly in the battle for survival.
 ✅ The OFFICIAL line-ups
 TORINO (3-5-2) : Perri; Coco, Ismajli, Comuzzo; Belghali, Vlasic, Mandragora, Fitz-Jim, Cacciamani; Adams, Simeone. Coach: Abate.
 MONZA (3-4-2-1): Tornqvist; Goglichidze, Lucchesi, Carboni; Birindelli, Foe Ondoa, Akinsanmiro, Mangas; Robinson, Mota; Varela. Coach: Juric.
